title: Innolight falls after a report said the US plans to restrict imports of new Chinese data center optical transceivers; 62% of its Q1 revenue came from the US (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Innolight falls after a report said the US plans to restrict imports of new Chinese data center optical transceivers; 62% of its Q1 revenue came from the US — Shares of Chinese optical module makers such as Zhongji Innolight (300308.SZ) slumped on Wednesday after a Reuters report …
